title: Evolution journal and direction pages say in plain words what changed and why nothing qualifies
review_independence_exception: Other model families are at terminal quota until 2026-11-27 10:03Z, so the reviewer is from the owner family (recorded per task brief).
hosted_verification: Not done here: no VM/SSH access. Functional evidence only; the operator acceptance task verifies hosted.
bff_contract_source: ajoe734/pantheon PR 7832 (BFF-EVO-JOURNAL-POOL-VERSIONS-20261125) BFF_API_CONTRACT.md, merge commit fed055997355c1067bb6b6eb757dd3564bbba7bc

acceptance_coverage.AC1: EvolutionJournalPage (_core.tsx) renders entry_type=pool_version rows: title '<persona name> · 策略池第 N 版' / '<persona> · strategy pool vN', applied/refused badge, members before/after, computed added/removed/changed lines, recorded reasons; raw id, machine title and summary are only in a collapsed technical details block (pool rows) or a muted secondary line (decision rows); decision rows get a plain title built from entry_type/action/target. include_system toggle (URL include_system=true, sent to the BFF) shows summary.hidden_system_counts (or decision_subject_class_counts when shown).
acceptance_coverage.AC2: Header: auto proposals total with threshold + incident_followup + incident_severity + infrastructure + other badges (BFF guarantees they add up; test asserts the sum equals the total); postmortem drafts are a separate line 'drafts, not proposals, not part of the total'; the separate Mutation reviews number is removed; pool version count shows applied + refused = total.
acceptance_coverage.AC3: EvolutionList (Lists.tsx) shows MemberBaselinesSection from data.member_baselines grouped by persona with status and a plain sentence per known owner reason code (all codes of services.evolution.approved_baselines plus registry_entry_unreadable / registry_read_unavailable); an unknown code gives a generic sentence plus 'Code: <raw>'; evaluated_at is shown in the viewer time zone with the zone name; criterion codes are secondary text.
acceptance_coverage.AC4: Programs recorded by the BFF/owner as test records (subject_class, record_class, classification, data_scope, origin_class, is_test, or origin in test/acceptance/fixture/synthetic/seed/sandbox) are behind a 'Show test records (N)' toggle; no name matching exists; a row with no classification stays visible (tested with the DEV ACCEPTANCE ONLY program shape). LIMITATION: the programs read in the BFF contract carries no classification field today, so the hosted DEV ACCEPTANCE ONLY draft (origin manual) will stay visible until the BFF records one; the page does not guess.
acceptance_coverage.AC5: Deep links decision/mutation_review/persona unchanged and tested (pool-version persona link and decision link); denied (401/403) vs unavailable (strategy_pools / 5xx) vs empty are distinct on both pages; locale parity: zh-TW and en-US keys added together and i18nParity test passes; focused tests plus real Chromium screenshots against a fixture BFF are in this directory.
acceptance_coverage.AC6: No test deleted or weakened; changed assertions are listed below with reasons.

changed_assertions.change: Four header/empty text expectations now use the new wording (threshold/infrastructure/other parts, no postmortem draft inside the proposals total); two expectations of the removed Mutation reviews number now assert it is absent.
changed_assertions.reason: AC2 explicitly removes the repeated mutation review number and moves postmortem drafts out of the proposal total (BFF contract: postmortem_draft is not part of total). Fixture numbers unchanged.

changed_assertions.change: qualification-evaluated-at expects the viewer-local formatted time instead of the raw ISO string.
changed_assertions.reason: AC3 requires the latest evaluation time in the viewer time zone.
The adapter now carries the BFF's new count parts; absent fields default to 0; all earlier fields unchanged.

changed_assertions.change: 角色任務→Persona 任務, 角色頁面→Persona 頁面, 已嘗試：momentum→已嘗試：動能 (ResearchList only).
changed_assertions.reason: Residual from FE-RESEARCH-DEMANDS-20261125 named in the task: Persona wording and no raw family code; meaning unchanged.

changed_assertions.change: qualification-evaluated-at: toHaveText(raw ISO SNAPSHOT_AT) -> toContainText(new Date(SNAPSHOT_AT).toLocaleString() evaluated in the browser) and not.toContainText(raw ISO)
changed_assertions.justification: Acceptance 3 requires the latest evaluation time in the viewer time zone. CI browser zone is UTC so the page shows '5/13/2026, 2:10:00 PM (UTC)'; the page is right and the raw-text expectation was stale. The new assertion is not weaker: it checks the formatted value and that no raw ISO leaks.
